title: Answer: intelligent, purposive behavior is the work of the nervous mechanism alone

statements.text: The view has no theory of intelligence. It holds that coordinated, purposive behavior, however complex, is produced by the nervous mechanism without the intervention of consciousness, so intelligence in action needs no conscious cause.

sources.quote: As actions of a certain degree of complexity are brought about by mere mechanism, why may not actions of still greater complexity be the result of a more refined mechanism?
